rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive filesystem capabilities including read/write operations, directory management, pattern-based searching with glob and grep, and shell command execution. Implements robust security through directory whitelisting, command approval lists, and dynamic access control. Enables desktop AI assistants to handle project-wide code refactoring, documentation updates, and complex file management tasks with security safeguards.
